recommendation: Keep the fix and review the next rendered toc.html to confirm Summary opens by default while Detail still contains the complete hierarchy.
issue_request: FHIR-19248 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether the long Code Systems and Value Sets sections in the FHIR core TOC could be collapsible or removed, and the approved resolution was to provide Summary and Detail tabs: Summary exposes the TOC only to the second level, while Detail preserves the complete page list.
initial_application: No source-history commit mentioning FHIR-19248 was found. Before this reconciliation, source/toc.html still contained a single <%toc%> placeholder under a Full Table of Contents heading, and current CI/R5 rendered pages showed one full generated TOC with 4.3 and 4.4 descendants expanded.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2019-12-02 confirm a 7-0-0 decision to split the TOC into two views. publish.ini lists toc.html as an active special page, making source/toc.html the correct in-scope source file. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip discussion or later Confluence decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/toc.html to add Summary and Detail tabs around the generated TOC. The Summary tab is built progressively by cloning the generated Detail table and removing rows deeper than level 2; the Detail tab remains the full generated table and the no-JavaScript fallback.
source_changes: source/toc.html: changed the TOC heading/description, added Summary and Detail tabs, and added progressive JavaScript to clone the generated TOC and remove entries deeper than level 2 from Summary.
